description: Elections Commission - Notify the 16th November, 2019 as the date of Poll for the Presidential Election
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the schedule for a presidential election, including the date of nomination (October 7, 2019), the place of nomination, and the polling date (November 16, 2019). It is issued by the Election Commission under the Presidential Elections Act and relates directly to electoral processes, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
